title: Director Jamie S. Gronowski reports 381,545 directly owned shares in Venu Holding Corp (VENU).
summary: Venu Holding Corp director Jamie S. Gronowski reported direct ownership of 381,545 shares of common stock as of September 23, 2026. This information was detailed in a Form 3 SEC filing, indicating an initial statement of beneficial ownership. title: Regional Opinion: The Oak Ridge Corridor — America’s nuclear address
summary: The article advocates for branding East Tennessee's concentrated nuclear assets as "the Oak Ridge Corridor," a term coined decades ago by Gov. Lamar Alexander. This corridor encompasses Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Y-12, TVA, and a growing private nuclear industry, representing an unparalleled concentration of nuclear science, energy, and national security capabilities. The author argues that this unified branding would help communicate the region's significance to investors, policymakers, and talent nationally and internationally.

title: PPL Corporation stock weighs Q2 miss against analyst upgrades
summary: PPL Corporation (PPL) stock closed at USD 32.81, below its yearly high, after reporting a Q2 revenue miss but also receiving renewed analyst support and upgrades. Despite the Q2 earnings per share falling short of consensus, the company reiterated its annual EPS guidance and announced a steady quarterly dividend. Analysts maintain price targets above USD 39, signaling confidence in PPL's long-term growth and its USD 23 billion infrastructure investment plan through 2029.

title: A 1,690-share award replaces cash retainers for TeraWulf (WULF) director Michael C. Bucella.
summary: TeraWulf Inc. director Michael C. Bucella received an award of 1,690 shares of common stock on September 30, 2026. These shares, valued at $14.80 each, were issued in lieu of cash retainers accrued since the third fiscal quarter of 2026, under the company's Non-Employee Director Compensation Policy. Following this transaction, Bucella's direct holdings in TeraWulf amount to 352,479 shares.

title: A director receives stock for 100% of Q3 retainer fees at Illumina (ILMN)
summary: Illumina director Scott B. Ullem acquired 113 shares of common stock on September 30, 2026, as part of his third-quarter 2026 board and committee cash retainer fees. He elected to receive 100% of these fees in stock, with the shares valued at $219.8037 each. Following this transaction, Ullem directly holds 11,143 shares in Illumina.

title: Kaplan Fox Deadline Alert: Taboola.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: TBLA) Invest
summary: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP has announced a class action lawsuit against Taboola.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: TBLA) for investors who purchased securities between May 6, 2026, and August 4, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Taboola.com misled investors regarding the value of its publisher relationships, which led to a significant drop in share price after the company reported lower-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings. Investors have until October 20, 2026, to seek a lead plaintiff role in the lawsuit.

title: PACCAR stock trades at USD 109.68 before October earnings
summary: PACCAR stock traded at USD 109.68 on October 2, 2026, ahead of its next earnings report scheduled for October 20, 2026. The company beat second-quarter expectations with adjusted EPS of USD 1.43 and revenue of USD 7.55 billion. RBC recently upgraded PACCAR to Outperform with a price target of USD 150, significantly above its current trading price.

title: The first of four stock installments gives Z Squared (ZSQR) tech chief Harris 12,444 shares.
summary: Z Squared Inc.'s Chief Technology Officer, Jeffery Keeslar Harris, received 12,444 common shares from the vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs) on September 24, 2026. This represents the first of four equal quarterly installments from a larger 49,778-RSU grant, with subsequent vesting dates through June 2027 contingent on his continued employment. After this transaction, Harris directly holds 12,444 common shares and 37,334 RSUs.

title: ExxonMobil stock faces Wells Fargo downgrade at USD 164.01
summary: ExxonMobil stock (XOM) was downgraded by Wells Fargo from Overweight to Equal Weight, though the bank maintained its USD 182 price target. The downgrade is attributed to relative valuation, with Wells Fargo seeing better upside in BP, despite ExxonMobil's strong Q2 GAAP earnings of USD 14.5 billion and Permian production exceeding 1.8 million oil-equivalent barrels per day. The stock closed at USD 164.01 on October 2, 2026, remaining below its yearly high.

title: Plug Power stock trades at USD 1.90 against a USD 3.59 consensus target
summary: Plug Power's stock recently traded at USD 1.90, despite a consensus analyst target of USD 3.59. The company reported Q2 2026 revenue of USD 178.3 million, a 2.5% increase year-over-year, and raised its full-year revenue growth guidance to 15-16%. While the company aims for positive EBITDAS by Q4 2026, it still faces a significant GAAP net loss and high operating cash burn.

title: American Tower stock gains 0.71 percent on Barclays target hike
summary: American Tower stock gained 0.71 percent on October 2, 2026, closing at USD 162.20 on the NYSE. This occurred after Barclays raised its price target for American Tower from USD 198 to USD 199, maintaining an Overweight rating. The company also reported Q2 revenue of USD 2.75 billion and net income of USD 867.5 million, with Q3 results expected on October 27, 2026.

title: Southern Company stock holds at USD 83.72 as earnings near surprisingly
summary: Southern Company's stock closed at USD 83.72 on October 2, 2026, with a market value of USD 96.3 billion. The company reported Q2 adjusted EPS of USD 1.13, beating consensus estimates by USD 0.12, although revenue of USD 6.98 billion fell short of analyst predictions. Citigroup maintained a Buy rating but lowered its price target to USD 104, while analysts await the Q3 earnings report scheduled for November 5, 2026.

title: Delta Air Lines Adds New U.S. City 4 Years After United Airlines Said Goodbye
summary: Delta Air Lines will begin nonstop service between Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC) and Flagstaff Pulliam Airport (FLG) in Arizona starting June 7, 2027. This twice-daily, year-round route marks Delta's entry into the Flagstaff market, which has been served solely by American Airlines since United Airlines suspended its service in 2022. The new flights will offer travelers improved access to popular northern Arizona destinations like Sedona and the Grand Canyon.

title: AMETEK stock gains 1.14 percent after fresh analyst coverage
summary: AMETEK stock rose 1.14% following new analyst coverage, which set a price target of USD 291. RBC Capital initiated coverage with a Buy rating. The company reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, exceeding consensus for both EPS and revenue, with a 15% increase in Q2 revenue.

title: Ross Stores stock falls 2.38 percent after board refresh
summary: Ross Stores (ISIN US7782961038) saw its stock fall by 2.38 percent to USD 228.54 on October 2, 2026, following a board refresh that took effect the previous day. Despite the stock drop, the retailer reported strong Q2 2026 results with sales rising 13 percent to USD 6.26 billion and diluted EPS reaching USD 2.66. The board expanded to 10 members with the appointment of two new independent directors, enhancing its expertise in technology, retail, and consumer investment.

title: Trimble stock secures a USD 500 million credit facility
summary: Trimble Inc. (TRMB) has secured a $500 million unsecured delayed draw term loan facility, providing financial flexibility for general corporate purposes. This comes as the company reported a 11.0% year-over-year revenue increase in Q2 2026, exceeding analyst expectations, and issued optimistic EPS guidance for Q3 and full-year 2026. Despite positive analyst sentiment, the stock remains below its 52-week high, with the next earnings report anticipated in November.

title: How Investors Are Reacting To Invesco Stock After New International ETF Launch
summary: Invesco recently launched a new international ETF, the Invesco Nasdaq International Innovators 100 ETF (QQI), which tracks 100 non-US companies focused on innovation. This new fund expands Invesco's QQQ Innovation Suite, aiming to generate fee revenue from international innovation themes and is aligned with its existing QQQ-branded ETFs. While analysts generally view this as part of Invesco's long-term growth strategy, some cautious analysts worry about intensified tech-led fee pressure.

title: Why Delta Air Lines' 282-Seat Airbus A330 Cannot Make The Math Work On Boston To Honolulu
summary: Delta Air Lines announced in February 2026 the restoration of nonstop service between Boston and Honolulu, utilizing a 282-seat Airbus A330-300 for what would be the longest domestic route. However, by August, 81% of planned departures were cut, with the service now running only for 17 days over the holidays and not returning in subsequent winters. This marks Delta's third retreat from the market in three years, following a similar struggle by Hawaiian Airlines, suggesting that the route cannot sustain the high costs of operating a large widebody aircraft for extended flight times from a market like Boston, especially compared to the stronger demand seen from New York.

title: SAP stock fell 1.51 percent as cloud growth stayed strong
summary: SAP's stock fell 1.51 percent to EUR 183.92 on Xetra, despite strong cloud revenue growth of 22 percent and a 27 percent increase in cloud backlog. The company's Q2 2026 update showed overall revenue up 9 percent and IFRS operating profit up 8 percent. Investors are balancing the company's cloud expansion against the valuation of its software business, with the cloud business execution being a key focus for future results.

title: Form 4 Twenty One Capital Inc For: 2 October By Investing.com
summary: This article from Investing.com reports on a Form 4 filing for Twenty One Capital Inc. on October 2nd. It notes the company's stock symbol is XXI and its stock experienced a -2.22% change. The article primarily serves as a brief announcement of the filing.

title: Under a trading plan, Stoke Therapeutics (STOK) medical chief sells 1,051 shares.
summary: Stoke Therapeutics' Chief Medical Officer, Barry Ticho, sold 1,051 shares of common stock on October 1, 2026, at a weighted-average price of $26.1594 per share. title: Jabil stock rises 1.54 percent after AI-led fiscal 2027 outlook
summary: Jabil Inc. saw its stock rise by 1.54% after reporting strong fiscal 2026 revenues of USD 35.954 billion and setting an ambitious fiscal 2027 revenue target of USD 44.5 billion, with AI infrastructure as the primary growth driver. Analysts from JPMorgan and Argus maintained their "Overweight" and "Buy" ratings respectively, with price targets significantly above the current market price, indicating confidence in Jabil's AI-driven expansion plans. The company's detailed fiscal 2027 outlook includes specific targets for core diluted earnings per share and core operating margin, despite identified risks such as supply chain issues and geopolitical factors.

title: DexCom stock gets a higher RBC target before Q3 results
summary: RBC Capital has raised its price target for DexCom (DXCM) from USD 90 to USD 105, maintaining an Outperform rating, ahead of the company's Q3 earnings report. Despite this positive analyst move, DexCom's stock closed down 1.01% at USD 85.36 on October 2, 2026, remaining below its 52-week high. The upcoming earnings report on October 29, 2026, will be crucial in assessing if Q2 revenue growth and the expansion into Type 2 diabetes are translating into continued earnings beats.

title: Wynn Resorts stock fell 1.84 percent near its 52-week low
summary: Wynn Resorts stock closed at USD 75.88 on October 2, 2026, falling 1.84 percent and remaining just USD 0.13 above its 52-week low. Despite beating Q2 earnings per share estimates, the stock's performance is affected by a reduced analyst price target from UBS and significant debt from expansion projects. The company's market capitalization stands at USD 7.9 billion, with a 52-week high of USD 134.72.

title: Live Nation Extends CEO Michael Rapino’s Contract
summary: Live Nation Entertainment has renewed and extended CEO Michael Rapino’s employment agreement until December 31, 2031. His compensation will heavily focus on performance-based equity and long-term incentives, including a $3 million base salary, a $17 million target cash bonus, and at least $10 million in annual performance-based restricted shares. The deal aims to ensure leadership continuity and align his rewards with shareholder value.

title: Ameriprise Financial stock gets a USD 5.5 billion buyback boost
summary: Ameriprise Financial's stock closed at USD 490.91 on October 2, 2026, after a slight decline. The company has announced a new USD 5.5 billion share repurchase program extending through September 30, 2028, providing flexibility in capital allocation. Investors are now looking to the Q3 2026 results, scheduled for October 29, 2026, as the next significant checkpoint for the company's financial performance and capital management strategy.

title: Halliburton stock takes a rating cut as target stays at USD 43.24
summary: Halliburton stock received a downgrade from Wall Street Zen from Buy to Hold on October 3, 2026, though the consensus price target remained at USD 43.24, significantly above the market price. The company's Q2 2026 results exceeded expectations, with revenue reaching USD 5.71 billion and adjusted EPS at USD 0.55. Despite strong international growth and margin improvement, Halliburton guided for a sequential decrease in Completion and Production, and Drilling and Evaluation revenues for Q3.

title: Omnicom Group stock reflects Q2 gains and lower targets
summary: Omnicom Group stock closed at USD 74.15, reflecting a 0.74% decrease, despite Q2 adjusted EPS rising by 29.3% to USD 2.65. Citigroup lowered its price target for Omnicom to USD 100, while Goldman Sachs maintained a higher target of USD 139, indicating analyst division on future growth. The company also raised its full-year 2026 organic revenue growth guidance and is set to release its Q3 2026 earnings on October 20, 2026.

title: Cardano’s RealFi Pays Up to 9% on Stablecoins. Can It Do for ADA What Tokenized Treasuries Did for the XRP Ledger?
summary: Cardano's new RealFi platform allows users to earn up to 9% annual yields on stablecoin deposits by channeling funds into institutional credit and emerging-market loans. While this could enhance Cardano's network by attracting institutional engagement, similar to how tokenized Treasuries benefited the XRP Ledger, it is unlikely to directly boost ADA's price significantly. The platform's benefits mainly accrue to stablecoin lenders and borrowers, with ADA only used for minimal network fees, reducing its direct price impact.

title: Norfolk Southern stock rises 2.28 percent as target falls
summary: Norfolk Southern (NSC) stock increased by 2.28% to USD 317.34 on October 2, 2026, despite Susquehanna lowering its price target from USD 386 to USD 350. The company reported Q2 2026 revenue of USD 3.465 billion, surpassing Q2 2025 figures, though its adjusted operating ratio widened. Investors are now looking to the Q3 2026 earnings release on October 22, 2026, for further insight into the company's performance.

title: Corning stock gains 2.33 percent after Truist target hike
summary: Corning Inc. stock rose 2.33% to USD 164.16 on October 2, 2026, following Truist's target price increase from USD 175 to USD 182, maintaining a buy rating. This surge was also fueled by a new multiyear fiber contract with AT&T valued at over USD 3 billion. The company reported strong Q2 2026 results and has an upcoming earnings report for Q3 2026 on November 3, 2026.

title: Sempra stock reports EPS growth as price holds near yearly low
summary: Sempra stock closed at USD 78.38 on October 2, 2026, with second-quarter adjusted EPS increasing by 30.3% to USD 1.16, while revenue remained largely flat. Despite the earnings growth, the stock price is near its 52-week low, trading USD 2.17 above it and USD 22.66 below its 52-week high. Analysts have mixed views, with Morgan Stanley lowering its target to USD 100 but maintaining an Overweight rating, and Scotiabank initiating coverage with a Sector Perform rating and an USD 83 target.

title: T-Mobile US stock rises as Scotiabank cuts target to USD 217
summary: T-Mobile US stock saw a slight rise despite Scotiabank lowering its price target from USD 232 to USD 217, maintaining a "sector outperform" rating. The stock closed at USD 163.64 on October 2, 2026, gaining 1.18 percent, with the new target still representing a significant upside. This development comes as T-Mobile US reported Q2 2026 earnings per share (EPS) of USD 2.99, exceeding the consensus estimate, and announced an increased quarterly dividend of USD 1.17 per share.

title: Verisk Analytics stock falls 2.67 percent before Q3 results
summary: Verisk Analytics' stock fell 2.67 percent to USD 163.88 on Nasdaq on October 2, 2026, ahead of its Q3 earnings report scheduled for November 5. This decline occurred despite the company beating Q2 adjusted EPS consensus and amid a fresh insider stock sale. Analysts have reset price targets lower, though the stock remains above its 52-week low.

title: NiSource stock reports mixed Q2 results as BMO cuts target
summary: NiSource (NI) reported mixed Q2 2026 results, with adjusted earnings per share up from consensus but down year-over-year, and revenue beating expectations. Following these results, BMO Capital lowered its price target for NiSource from USD 49 to USD 45, citing regulatory clarity despite maintaining an Outperform rating. The company reaffirmed its 2026 EPS guidance and long-term growth targets, with its stock closing near its yearly low.

title: Nordson Corp stock gains 1.37 percent near its yearly high
summary: Nordson Corp's stock gained 1.37 percent, reaching a price of USD 333.54, which is just 1.6 percent below its 52-week high. This surge follows a strong fiscal Q3 2026 performance where adjusted EPS and revenue both beat consensus estimates. The company also raised its full-year sales and adjusted EPS guidance, with analysts like Oppenheimer increasing their price targets.

title: W.W. Grainger stock reports 10.3 percent sales growth in Q2 2026
summary: W.W. Grainger Inc. reported strong Q2 2026 results, with sales growing 10.3 percent year-over-year to USD 5.021 billion and diluted EPS reaching USD 12.01, exceeding analyst expectations. The company also raised its fiscal 2026 guidance for EPS to USD 45.50-47.25, reflecting tariff refunds and sales momentum. Despite this, analyst ratings remain divided, with Barclays lowering its price target while maintaining an Underweight rating.

title: Progressive Corp stock faces Q3 test as August premiums rise 6 percent
summary: Progressive Corp (PGR) saw August net premiums written rise 6 percent year over year to $7.605 billion, though net income fell 22 percent to $951 million. While policy growth continued, the combined ratio deteriorated, pointing to weaker underwriting efficiency. The company's upcoming Q3 results on October 21, 2026, will be a key indicator for investors, especially after a strong Q2 diluted EPS beat.

title: Allison Transmission redeems $100m of 2027 senior notes By Investing.com
summary: Allison Transmission Holdings Inc. (NYSE:ALSN) announced a partial redemption of $100 million of its 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027. The redemption was made at 100.00% of the principal amount plus accrued interest. Following this transaction, $300 million of the notes remain outstanding.

title: Booking Holdings stock reports 8.1 percent Q2 revenue growth
summary: Booking Holdings reported an 8.1% year-over-year revenue growth for Q2 2026, reaching $7.35 billion, and adjusted EPS of $2.54, both exceeding analyst estimates. However, management provided a more modest Q3 revenue growth guidance of 4% to 6%. The company also repurchased $7.4 billion in shares during the first half of 2026, and its stock closed at $159.02 on Nasdaq on October 2, 2026, below its 52-week high.

title: Target Corporation stock enters a pricing test after HSBC upgrade
summary: Target Corporation's stock is undergoing a pricing test following an HSBC upgrade that raised its price target from USD 125 to USD 190. This comes as Target implements price cuts on 2,000 items and prepares for "Circle Deal Days" ahead of the holiday shopping season. Despite a strong fiscal Q2 revenue increase and improved operating margin, the stock remains below its 52-week high, and the long-term impact of its pricing strategy on underlying profit durability is under scrutiny.

title: Deere (DE) Stock Trades Close To Fair Value On Cash Flow
summary: Deere (DE) stock is currently trading close to its fair value based on discounted cash flow analysis, with its share price around US$687. The company's business mix is shifting towards construction and smaller equipment, and its future cash flow projections are expected to grow, aligning with the current valuation. While some narratives support this fair valuation, others suggest the stock might be overvalued, highlighting the importance of evaluating growth, profitability, and earnings assumptions.

title: ConocoPhillips stock trades below its yearly high as earnings near
summary: ConocoPhillips stock is trading below its yearly high as it approaches its third-quarter earnings report on November 5, 2026. The company reported strong second-quarter adjusted EPS of USD 3.24, exceeding consensus, and analysts have a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average 12-month price target of USD 141.24. Investors will be closely watching the upcoming earnings to see if the company can maintain its positive operating performance.

title: DuPont stock reports stronger Q2 earnings and 2026 guidance
summary: DuPont de Nemours (DD) reported stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings, with adjusted EPS of $1.88, surpassing consensus estimates. The company raised its full-year 2026 outlook for net sales and adjusted EPS, reflecting a positive performance. Despite a recent price target cut by Goldman Sachs, the stock's future performance hinges on converting the raised outlook into cash generation, with current trading below its yearly high.

title: Automatic Data Processing stock falls 2.38 percent on October 2
summary: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) stock fell 2.38% on October 2, 2026, closing at USD 257.68 on Nasdaq. Despite the dip, analysts maintain a "Hold" consensus with an average target of USD 273.50. The company reported strong quarterly numbers, beating EPS consensus and achieving USD 5.47 billion in revenue, with its next earnings report scheduled for October 28, 2026.

title: Valero Energy stock reports 48.8 percent revenue growth
summary: Valero Energy reported a significant 48.8% revenue growth in Q2 2026, reaching USD 44.48 billion, with EPS at USD 12.54, beating consensus. title: Optional share sales carry a 3% commission under Silynxcom (SYNX)'s new agreement.
summary: Silynxcom Ltd. has entered into an at-the-market sales agreement with ThinkEquity LLC, allowing it to sell ordinary shares periodically. The company will pay a 3.0% commission on the aggregate gross proceeds from each sale and intends to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. Either party can terminate the agreement with five days' notice.

title: Autodesk stock trades at USD 212 as revenue grows 16 percent
summary: Autodesk's stock closed at USD 212.00 on October 2, 2026, after reporting fiscal second-quarter revenue of USD 2.05 billion, marking a 16.1% year-over-year increase. The company also provided fiscal 2027 guidance, projecting revenue between USD 8.295 billion and USD 8.345 billion, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with a target price significantly above the current trading price. The strong revenue growth and positive guidance keep growth central to the investment case for Autodesk.

title: A proposed $349K share sale at Toast (TOST) includes shares to cover officer Elena C. Gomez’s tax obligation.
summary: Toast (TOST) officer Elena C. Gomez has proposed a sale of 11,886 Class A shares, valued at approximately $348,900.47, with an approximate sale date of October 2, 2026.
